::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 13th 1875  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Columbia University Library, New York:  Lohf Collection
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

[Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) has sent me proofs of the [French history](cmy_books/cmybook_99.qmd), but would it not be better to wait to print till I have finished, as the limits are fixed? 

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
